note: Outside the stated ICP on four of five criteria. A 29-year-old salaried government desk worker in Odisha, not a business owner, physician or equivalent; the price converted to roughly 400,000 rupees and he confirmed it was outside his budget. Health is not the neglected corner of an otherwise successful life — an autoimmune joint disease is the whole reason he is on the call, and what he is seeking is relief rather than the last increment of a good physique. He clears the exclusion criterion easily: at 5'8" and around 138 lb, having trained six days a week for a year and currently doing yoga, he is neither deconditioned nor gym-averse. Two things about this one matter for the ICP work rather than for this call. First, the criteria as written have no clinical dimension at all, and this is the prospect who most needed one — the observation already recorded against the Tyron Giuliani call now has a second and sharper instance. Second, the funnel is producing internationally-sourced leads from free YouTube content whom the price cannot serve, and the rep had no framework for that conversation other than raising national income himself.
